blocks.label: Re-anchor
blocks.text: Following up on my note from last week, in case it slipped past.

blocks.label: New angle
blocks.guidance: Add exactly ONE new, specific point that was NOT in the first email: a concrete detail about them (a launch, hire, market move) tied in one clause to a single piece of the candidate's evidence, framed as why a part-time pair of hands would be useful now. Two sentences at most. Do not restate the first email. No 'just checking in'.

blocks.label: Single ask
blocks.text: Worth a 15-minute call in the next week or two? Happy to work around you.

style.notes: A follow-up is a nudge, not a re-pitch. Shorter than the original, one new reason to reply, one clear ask. Respect their time; brevity is the signal. Warm but not apologetic, never needy.
